recipe.criteria: Single left-leg press on a 45-degree sled. Working knee extends from 95 to 165 degrees over 4 seconds and returns over 4 seconds. Entire foot on plate, other foot on a separate fixed support; hands, back and pelvis remain fixed.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
